note: Both sets suffer from significant redundancy and share a common error misinterpreting the diagram's deformation phase as involving Austenite. Set A is preferred because it consistently extracts the correct temperature value (200C) with better quote support, whereas Set B hallucinates a negative sign (-200C) in one claim while getting it right in another. Set A has one claim mislabeling pull force as friction, but this semantic imprecision is less severe than Set B's numerical data error.
